core_principles: Data-rich but visually clean (Control Room Grid)
Glass layers, soft shadows, and modular cards
Dense command palettes (Cmd+K) for power users

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3, and modular card titles.

body.usage: Use for body text, form labels, smaller UI elements.

mono.usage: Use for numerical data, financial KPIs, and code/automation IDs.

layout_spacing.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID (Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, tight gap-4 or gap-6)
layout_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for inner elements, rounded-full for buttons

visual_effects.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl with 1px semi-transparent inner border to ground the card
visual_effects.motion: Use Framer Motion for ambient background rotation, staggered bento grid item entrance, and Cmd+K palette scale-in. Use CSS transitions (transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease) for hover states.

components.navigation: Three-pane layout: Fixed Left Rail Nav (w-64 or w-20 collapsed) + Top Header (Workspace Switcher + Search/Cmd+K) + Fixed Right Sidebar Dock (AI Copilot/Helix).
components.executive_dashboard: KPI Cockpit: Grid of metric cards. Revenue, Pipeline, MRR, Client Health, Team Capacity, Automation Savings. Recharts for dynamic sparklines inside cards.
components.crm_kanban: Horizontal scroll area with column headers. Drag and drop style modular cards. Pipeline stages: Lead, Discovery, Proposal, Won, Onboard, Delivery, Growth, Renewal.
components.ai_copilot: Slide-out panel or right-dock. Theme it with a subtle amber/blue gradient mesh background to distinguish 'Agent OS (Helix)' from standard UI.
components.command_palette: Triggered via Cmd+K. Huge text input (text-2xl), instantly filters global search, actions, and navigation. Dense, keyboard-first.
components.buttons: Always explicitly define hover text color (e.g. hover:bg-neutral-200 hover:text-black).
components.data_display: Use Recharts. Minimalist axes, remove grid lines or use very subtle dashed lines. Tooltips must use glassmorphism styles.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements must have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-crm-link', data-testid='kpi-revenue-card')

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize HTML/Tailwind for the dashboard layout (Control Room grid). Use pure div grids for complex bento metrics.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions: Dialog (Command Palette), Select (Workspace Switcher), Tabs (Client/Projects view).
Ensure 'REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL' is used for all fetch requests.
Implement Framer Motion for layout transitions and staggered entrances.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Inject Cabinet Grotesk from Fontshare or Google Fonts.
Never use generic placeholder images. Use provided assets.
Strictly follow the light/dark mode variants using standard Tailwind 'dark:' prefix, and setup a global theme provider.
